phase_notes.before: Economical verifier before the explicit sentence coverage manifest. Four invalid-schema model replies remain null and count as failures.
phase_notes.after: Same economical model with explicit sentence coverage. Its first score was 16/18 under the original attribution policy. Replaying these IDENTICAL recorded replies after the generic packaging/document-disagreement attribution repair scores 18/18; that final delta used no additional inference.
phase_notes.reference: Stronger-model diagnostic comparison on the same already inspected challenge set; not an oracle and not a held-out trial.

historical_initial.treatment: Frozen original report retained unchanged. Its initial after result is historical, not recomputed with the repaired policy.

current_policy_replay.scope: 12 synthetic product-copy challenges; exact candidate annotations, not live platform or customer success.
limitations: Small manually annotated test set, not a representative population estimate.
Exact-candidate matching exposes omissions but can under-credit overlapping legitimate wording.
Verbatim receipts alone do not establish semantic entailment; gold labels are separate from the validator.
No model or network requests are made by this scorer; inference costs belong to the calling validation ledger.
Any after phase informed by failures is a retrospective regression result, not held-out generalization.
